notes: AC network: series 5H inductor + 49F cap from the top-left node to the centre node; 8cos(t)V source from the centre node to ground; 30sin(8t+15)A source from the centre node to the top-right; 51F cap down the right side to the bottom rail; 55ohm resistor down the left side in series with the 50F cap back to the bottom rail. Net map: n4 = top-left corner (215,400)-(210,437): left lead of L(#2) + top lead of R(#3). n3 = the short rail (460,404)-(496,402) between the inductor's right lead and the 49F cap's left lead. n1 = top centre rail (560,402)->(705,401) including the drop at x=619 to the V-AC top: right lead of C49(#1), left lead of I-AC(#0), top of V-AC(#5). n2 = top-right rail (806,398)->(890,443): right lead of I-AC(#0) + top plate of the 51F cap(#4). n5 = bottom-left path (213,548)->(210,600)->(320,600)->(320,533)->(350,532): bottom of R(#3) + left plate of the 50F cap(#6). 0 = the bottom rail (416,534)->(470,535)->(470,605)->(890,600) plus the vertical from V-AC down through the GND symbol: right plate of C50(#6), bottom plate of C51(#4), bottom of V-AC(#5), GND(#7). Site decisions: S5 (619,402) CRITICAL = junction - the crop is an unambiguous T, the vertical drop to the V-AC top ends on the horizontal top rail, no hop and no need for one; reading it as a crossing is not even available at deg=3 and would strand the V-AC top terminal. S12 (624,600) CRITICAL = junction - the vertical from the V-AC bottom crosses the horizontal bottom rail and continues down into the GND symbol; no hop/jog and no separating dot, and the drafter draws no hop anywhere on this sheet. The alternative (crossing: bottom rail passes under, ground wire independent) would leave the V-AC bottom + GND as a 2-terminal net with no return path for the source current, i.e. an electrically impossible reading - rule 1 settles it. Non-critical sites S1,S2,S3,S4 (label strokes of '49F' and '5H' brushing the cap/inductor boxes), S7 ('55 ohm' text touching the resistor box), S8 ('50F' text), S9/S10 ('8 cos' text touching the V-AC circle) are all handwriting ink, left at default; none of them carries current.
